title: US software stocks scale fresh 2026 highs as AI disruption worries fade
key_facts: S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3% on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026 to the highest since Nov 2025.
It posted its biggest July-September quarterly gain since Q2 2020.
Sector expected 2026 earnings growth is 20.6%, up from 13.8% at end-March (LSEG).
The index fell more than 26% from late January to April on fears AI would let firms build software in-house.
Strong results from Salesforce, ServiceNow and Accenture helped.
Zacks' Brian Mulberry says the real test could come in the second half of 2027.
quote_evidence: AI has been more of an enabler for a lot of these software companies, more than a disruptor, said Adam Turnquist of LPL Financial.
The real test for software stocks could come in the second half of 2027.
why_it_matters_hint: Software shares are recovering as AI is seen helping, not replacing, the sector.
